problem: Production Release Readback intermittently timed out waiting for a visible body on /prijzen even though the immediately preceding targeted route verification on the same live deploy succeeded.
root_cause: The dedicated pricing verifier had a single 15s readiness attempt. A transient browser/navigation/render delay could fail the readback before any actual pricing interaction was tested.
prevention: Use at most two bounded readiness attempts with a fresh cache-busting nonce.
Require visible body and attached pricing runtime before interaction assertions begin.
Do not retry individual business interactions or use force-click; lifecycle, plan, billing and English-route checks remain strict.
Fail closed after the second readiness failure and preserve exact live SHA/deploy identity.

evidence.pricing_failure: body visible timeout before interaction proof
